name: Eye of Medusa

features.name: Medusa cascades
features.description: Medusa stays through low-paying wins and petrifies high-paying symbols, which sink to the bottom.

features.name: Petrified multipliers
features.description: At the end of a cascade, petrified symbols reveal up to 500x and Medusa adds up to 20x.

features.name: Two bonus rounds
features.description: Snakes & Stones gives 10–12 spins, and Gorgon's Gold gives 12 spins with a minimum Medusa multiplier.

review:
A 5x5 ways game with Super Cascades and Medusa changing every cascade. On a low-paying win she stays put while the rest refills; on a high-paying win those symbols turn to stone and sink to the bottom with her.

When the cascade ends, the stones reveal multipliers up to 500x and Medusa boosts the total by up to 20x. Three or four FS give 10 or 12 Snakes & Stones spins; five give Gorgon's Gold, where Medusa's minimum multiplier can grow. 10,000x max.
